submittedParameters.prompt:
Edit ONLY BOTH LEGS below the waist into a clear RIGHT-SUPPORT / LEFT-PASSING running phase. Preserve the entire head, face, hair, both arms/hands/props, upper body, coat, camera and character scale. Current near anatomical LEFT knee and shoe are still folded behind the pelvis; that is the defect. Redraw this near LEFT thigh sweeping FORWARD toward screen lower-left, with knee lifted at the front of the pelvis. Its flexed lower leg and shoe hang above ground, passing beside the supporting leg in a parallel running lane, NOT kicking sideways. Its heel-to-toe axis points screen lower-left, following the run direction. The FAR anatomical RIGHT leg is the weight-bearing support: thigh descends from far viewer-left hip, knee slightly bent under the pelvis, shin nearly vertical, shoe planted flat directly beneath the body. Its heel-to-toe axis also points screen lower-left. Keep distinct continuous hip-knee-ankle chains, two legs, two shoes. The near lifted left thigh overlaps the far right upper leg at the pelvis; both knees and shoe silhouettes remain readable. Do not stretch or rescale the whole figure, do not reposition the head, do not change the two hands or five cards, no shadow/background.
Output the edited full transparent RGBA sprite at native resolution at least 1024x1024.
